name: io.github.jamiew/monarch-mcp
title: Monarch MCP Server
description: Query and update Monarch Money accounts, transactions, and budgets

environmentVariables.name: MONARCH_MFA_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: TOTP secret for 2FA, not a rotating code

environmentVariables.name: MONARCH_FORCE_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to skip the cached session

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Filter transactions by date, account, or category

tools.name: update_transaction_splits
tools.description: Replace all splits; an empty list removes them

tools.name: get_recurring_transactions
tools.description: Read scheduled occurrences, not payment status; date filters unreleased

tools.name: update_recurring_transaction
tools.description: Unreleased: edit merchant-wide recurrence, not posted transactions

tools.name: get_spending_summary
tools.description: Group spending by category, account, or month

tools.name: get_complete_financial_overview
tools.description: Combine accounts, transactions, budgets, cashflow, and categories

tools.name: analyze_spending_patterns
tools.description: Summarize trends with optional average-based forecasts

securityConsiderations: Unofficial API access requires Monarch credentials with full read/write access. Protect credentials, session tokens, and logs, which may contain financial inputs and error details.
